infobox.usage: Unlocks the door to the server room on Icebreaker.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Compartment C-1 keycard (C-1) is a Keycard in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A plain keycard belonging to the captain. Someone has handwritten "C-1 Boreas" on it with a marker.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - This is a required location for the story chapter Boreas

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text: In the left hand of a body on level 9 of Icebreaker. A single keycard is guaranteed to spawn every raid.

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Door to the server room on level 7 of Icebreaker.
